Operating threshold for the integrity-risk score
selected on the training split, carried to evaluation unchanged

Chosen on the TRAINING split and read back from the experiment bundle. STATS-10 refuses to recompute it from the evaluation scores: choosing a threshold on the split you then report is threshold-provenance leakage (L6), and it would flatter every metric below it.
argmax F1 over the precision-recall curve

The point on the precision-recall curve that maximises F1. Used by STATS-12 to bucket errors, and deliberately NOT used as the operating threshold: it is selected on the same scores it is then evaluated on.

lambda + z * sqrt(lambda) * sd_inflation, with z = 3.0. The inflation factor is the measured overdispersion of real trade counts; a Poisson band (inflation 1) was measured to be wrong and there is no fallback to it. Without the Week 2 result the detector raises MissingWeek2Input rather than guessing.
piecewise-linear cap on exposure as a function of integrity risk

Full allowance at or below risk 0.30, zero allowance at or above 0.80, linear in between, floored at 0.00. Uncertainty widens the effective risk by 0.50 x uncertainty, so an uncertain high reading is treated at least as cautiously as a confident one.
